description: Connects a hostname (e.g. www) to a website hosted on RunLite: proves ownership for its HTTPS certificate, then points the hostname at RunLite's CDN.
variableDescription: acmToken/acmTarget: the variable parts of the AWS Certificate Manager ownership CNAME (_<acmToken> -> _<acmTarget>.acm-validations.aws). cfTarget: the site's CloudFront distribution label (<cfTarget>.cloudfront.net).
